source_documents.title: Mechanochromism induced through the interplay between excimer reaction and excited state intramolecular proton transfer

reference_evidence_units.quote: a major red emission band appears at 600 nm
reference_evidence_units.subject: CF3-HTTH
reference_evidence_units.conditions: Pristine solid powder at room temperature; Fig. 1c, excitation 380 nm.
reference_evidence_units.statement: Normal/vibronic emission around 440-460 nm and tautomer emission around 520 nm coexist with a broad 600 nm band.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: Band locations used for maxima and monitoring differ (e.g., 550/650 nm); do not treat every monitoring wavelength as a peak maximum.

reference_evidence_units.quote: disappears when CF3-HTTH is deposited as a thin film
reference_evidence_units.subject: CF3-HTTH
reference_evidence_units.conditions: Comparison of powder, solution, vapor-deposited quartz film and PMMA; PMMA result reported from SI.
reference_evidence_units.statement: The broad red band is absent in solution and deposited/dispersed films, supporting a packing-dependent intermolecular origin.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: SI PMMA data not inspected; absence of the band in these conditions does not mean all aggregate states are nonemissive.

reference_evidence_units.quote: CF3-MTTH with ESIPT reveals negligible excimer emission
reference_evidence_units.subject: CF3-MTTH and CF3-MTTM
reference_evidence_units.conditions: Methylated controls and crystal analysis, Fig. 1 and Table 1.
reference_evidence_units.statement: MTTH supports ESIPT but little excimer, while fully methylated MTTM can form an excimer without ESIPT. Packing and excited-state competition both matter.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: Comparator behavior is not transferred to target. ESIPT is not a universal prerequisite for excimer formation.

reference_evidence_units.quote: a long rise component of 400 ps is obvious
reference_evidence_units.subject: CF3-HTTH
reference_evidence_units.conditions: Pristine powder, room temperature; 400 nm excitation; TCSPC monitoring 650 nm, Fig. 2a/Table 2 visually inspected.
reference_evidence_units.statement: Excimer-dominated red emission rises in about 400 ps and decays in about 2.4 ns; normal and tautomer signals have matching approximately 400 ps decays.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: Observed 400 ps is a coupled kinetic time constant, not an independently measured elementary excimer-formation rate.

reference_evidence_units.quote: decay time of the normal emission (460 nm) of 3.9 ± 0.2 ps
reference_evidence_units.subject: CF3-HTTH
reference_evidence_units.statement: Normal emission decay of 3.9 +/- 0.2 ps matches tautomer rise of 3.8 +/- 0.2 ps, followed by a longer decay.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: Instrument response about 120 fs; fit uncertainty and reversible proton transfer must be retained.

reference_evidence_units.quote: The forward (kpt) and reverse (k−pt) ESIPT are fitted
reference_evidence_units.subject: CF3-HTTH
reference_evidence_units.conditions: Coupled N*, T*, E* rate-equation simulation; Eqs. 3-8 and methods p.8.
reference_evidence_units.statement: Authors fit forward/reverse ESIPT times of 4.6/26 ps and coupled 362 ps N*/T* decay/E* rise; reversible ESIPT channels population through N* to E*.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: Model-dependent fits; kT is taken from CF3-MTTH. These are reported author simulations, not new calculations. Fig. 5 inset contains an apparent 362 ns typo unlike equations.

reference_evidence_units.quote: the emission spectra become similar to that of pristine powder
reference_evidence_units.subject: CF3-HTTH
reference_evidence_units.conditions: Crystal grinding at room temperature, Fig. 6 on p.7 visually inspected.
reference_evidence_units.statement: Grinding increases relative normal/tautomer contributions and makes the crystal spectrum resemble powder; vapor-deposited film lacks the excimer band.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: Normalized spectra show relative spectral redistribution, not absolute integrated quantum-yield changes.

reference_evidence_units.quote: crystal surface has significantly more and narrower lifetime distribution at 1.5–1.7 ns
reference_evidence_units.subject: CF3-HTTH
reference_evidence_units.conditions: Two-photon microscopy, 800 nm excitation; surface vs approximately 6 micrometers depth, Fig. 7 visually inspected.
reference_evidence_units.statement: Crystal interior is more excimer-dominated; the surface shows larger 1.5-1.7 ns normal/tautomer components.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: Three-exponential fitting and spatial resolution limit separation; surface spectra can still contain red contributions, so do not call the measured surface entirely excimer-free.

reference_evidence_units.quote: proper orientation of neighbor molecules facilitates the for- mation of excimer after fast equilibrium of ESIPT reaction.
reference_evidence_units.subject: CF3-HTTH
reference_evidence_units.conditions: Discussion of morphology and depth-resolved spectra.
reference_evidence_units.statement: Authors explain mechanochromism by different surface/interior packing that alters excimer formation after reversible ESIPT equilibration.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: Bounded source model: not a generic RIM assignment and not demonstrated for every congener.

reference_mechanisms.label: PACKING_HOST_MATRIX_CONFINEMENT
reference_mechanisms.rationale: Packing and surface-to-interior morphology control intermolecular excited-state formation and spectral balance.

reference_mechanisms.label: ESIPT_PT
reference_mechanisms.rationale: Matched normal decay/tautomer rise and reversible kinetic modeling support ESIPT coupled to later excimer population.

reference_mechanisms.label: AGGREGATE_EXCITON_EXCIMER
reference_mechanisms.rationale: Broad red-band morphology dependence and delayed formation support the authors' excimer interpretation, not just generic aggregation.

reference_mechanisms.label: RADIATIVE_RATE_STATE_BALANCE
reference_mechanisms.rationale: Explicit coupled N*/T*/E* populations provide a state-balance interpretation. This overlaps with ESIPT/excimer kinetics and does not imply independently measured radiative rates.

mechanism_decisions.label: RIM_RIR_RIV
mechanism_decisions.rationale: No target-specific restriction of internal motion is established here; AIE or aggregation alone is insufficient.

evidence: figure 1a: CF3 para to OH, meta to the ring junction
